_comment: Edit this file to add your own sources. The checker runs every 6h and reads this file fresh each time. Supported types: 'subscription' (a URL that returns a list of v2ray links) and 'telegram' (a Telegram channel @username that posts v2ray links in MESSAGE TEXT — file attachments cannot be scraped without Telegram API auth). After editing, just commit/push — the workflow picks it up automatically on the next run.

subscriptions.name: barry-far
subscriptions._note: disabled 2026-10-25: repo was blocked by GitHub (DMCA?), returns 404

subscriptions.name: mifa-world
subscriptions._note: the temporary sub link that ShadowProxy66 telegram channel pins; ~200 v2ray configs, refreshed regularly

telegram_channels.name: ShadowProxy66
telegram_channels._note: disabled 2026-10-25: this channel posts configs as .txt FILE ATTACHMENTS, not inline text. t.me/s/{user} public preview does NOT expose file downloads without Telegram API auth. Use the mifa.world/power subscription above instead — that's the actual sub link pinned in the channel.
